subject.title: fix(gateway): stop health monitor from undoing crash-loop give-up

question: After the channel manager exhausts its crash-loop restart budget, should the account remain stopped until explicit operator action, or may the health monitor revive it under a separate bounded policy?
rationale: Current main explicitly tests post-give-up health-monitor revival, while this PR makes give-up terminal; source-level correctness cannot determine the intended operator and availability contract.

options.title: Make give-up terminal
options.body: Treat exhausted manager retries as authoritative and require explicit operator action before another channel start.

options.title: Preserve bounded revival
options.body: Fix active-backoff counter ownership while retaining a separately budgeted health-monitor recovery path after give-up.

recommendation.title: Make give-up terminal
recommendation.body: Treat exhausted manager retries as authoritative and require explicit operator action before another channel start.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the strongest continuing ownership of gateway health-monitor recovery semantics and policy extraction.
